stages.purpose: Capture the human need without introducing implementation technology.
reviewQuestions: Is the need expressed without language, framework, file, or provider decisions?

stages.purpose: State the observable condition that satisfies the admitted intent.
reviewQuestions: Is the outcome observable without prescribing its implementation?
stages.completionCondition: one desired outcome and its observable state are complete

stages.purpose: Establish one canonical feature identity and user story from the admitted outcome.
reviewQuestions: Does the feature preserve the intent and desired outcome without adding implementation meaning?
stages.completionCondition: one canonical feature identity, story, and governing obligation are complete

stages.purpose: Decompose the feature into focused observable behavior transitions.
reviewQuestions: Does every scenario contain focused preconditions, one responsibility transition, and observable outcomes?
stages.completionCondition: every required feature behavior is represented by one focused scenario

stages.purpose: Extract exactly one governing obligation from every scenario.
reviewQuestions: Does each obligation express exactly the meaning that its scenario requires?
stages.completionCondition: every scenario has one complete obligation

stages.purpose: Declare the disposition expected when each scenario obligation is satisfied.
reviewQuestions: Is each expected disposition independently comparable with observed execution?
stages.completionCondition: every scenario has one expectation bound to one signal

stages.purpose: Assign one accountable responsibility to satisfy each admitted obligation.
reviewQuestions: Does each responsibility own one semantic transition and no unrelated policy?
stages.completionCondition: every obligation has one responsible semantic operation

stages.purpose: Declare the observable signal produced by every responsibility.
reviewQuestions: Can every declared signal be observed without reading the expectation during execution?
stages.completionCondition: every responsibility produces one expectation-bound signal

stages.purpose: Define the language-neutral observations, decisions, and projections owned by every responsibility.
reviewQuestions: Does semantic authority own every decision and result shape required by the responsibility?
stages.completionCondition: every responsibility has complete language-neutral semantic authority

stages.purpose: Order the admitted semantic operations into directly executable models.
reviewQuestions: Can the semantic model execute directly without projected source code?
stages.completionCondition: every semantic authority has one deterministic execution model

stages.purpose: Collapse each semantic execution edge into one language-neutral executable body.
reviewQuestions: Does each body invoke only its admitted semantic edge and introduce no domain meaning?
stages.completionCondition: every responsibility has one complete constrained feature body

stages.purpose: Bind each feature body to one admitted language and module profile.
reviewQuestions: Does the selected language profile translate the body without changing its meaning?
stages.completionCondition: every feature body has one admitted language projection

stages.purpose: Project each feature body into the complete expected language AST.
reviewQuestions: Can every AST node be traced to feature-body authority?
stages.completionCondition: every projected body has one complete expected AST

stages.purpose: Render expected source code exclusively from the admitted AST.
reviewQuestions: Does every source construct come from the expected AST with no hand-authored additions?
stages.completionCondition: every expected AST renders one deterministic source body

stages.purpose: Execute semantic authority directly and observe its signals.
reviewQuestions: Was the semantic result observed without using the expected result as execution input?
stages.completionCondition: every semantic execution produces one observed signal

stages.purpose: Execute the projected embodiment and observe its signals independently.
reviewQuestions: Was the projected result observed through the same fixture boundary as semantic execution?
stages.completionCondition: every projected body produces one independently observed signal

stages.purpose: Compare declared expectations, semantic observations, and projected observations.
reviewQuestions: Are the declared, semantic, and projected outcomes canonically equivalent?
stages.completionCondition: every responsibility has one terminal translation determination

stages.purpose: Present the complete construction lineage for human implementation admission.
reviewQuestions: Is every implementation construct traceable through AST, body, semantic authority, and feature intent?
stages.completionCondition: one review disposition covers the complete canonical feature

intent.trigger: one previously nonexistent reviewed feature is submitted to the governed conveyor
intent.need: construct the complete canonical feature and its executable embodiment in admitted causal order
intent.purpose: prove that the conveyor can build new behavior without bypassing authority or inventing meaning during projection

constraints.text: intent and canonical behavior remain language-neutral
no construction stage may consume an output that has not been admitted
language projection introduces no meaning absent from canonical authority
execution cannot read the expected result to manufacture its observed result

outcome.statement: One previously nonexistent reviewed feature is constructed, projected, executed, and reviewed entirely from admitted canonical authority.

observableState.text: the canonical feature and every focused scenario are visible
every obligation, expectation, responsibility, signal, and semantic execution is visible
every language-neutral body, expected AST, and expected source projection is visible
semantic execution, projected execution, and declared expectations are canonically equivalent

feature.title: Implement one new feature end to end through a governed conveyor

userStory.iWant: one previously nonexistent reviewed feature implemented through the governed conveyor
userStory.soThat: its executable behavior and complete origin can be independently reproduced and reviewed

feature.governingObligation: Every accepted construction begins with reviewed intent, advances only through eligible stages, and conserves canonical meaning through semantic and projected execution.

background.text: review authority is supplied independently of the feature implementation
construction, semantic, language, and runtime profiles are pinned

given.text: its feature identity is absent from the implementation root

when.text: the request is evaluated against construction eligibility

then.text: one new-feature request admission is observed

obligation.statement: Only one complete, reviewed, previously nonexistent feature request may enter construction.

signal.statement: The reviewed request is admitted or rejected with one deterministic disposition.

resultShape.rationale: The signal reports terminal admission status; reviewed request identity remains in lineage authority.

when.text: the admitted request is projected through every canonical construction stage

then.text: one complete canonical new-feature authority is observed

obligation.statement: The admitted request must produce complete feature, scenario, obligation, expectation, responsibility, signal, and semantic authority.

signal.statement: Every required canonical construction product exists and is causally linked.

resultShape.rationale: The signal reports completion status; constructed authority remains in governed artifacts.

when.text: every admitted body and language projection is materialized

then.text: one complete projected new-feature materialization is observed

obligation.statement: Materialization must derive every executable body from admitted feature-body and AST authority.

signal.statement: Every expected artifact exists and reproduces its admitted AST.

resultShape.rationale: The signal reports materialization status; artifact identities and hashes remain in projection evidence.

when.text: the materialized feature executes through its admitted semantic edges

then.text: one new-feature execution observation is produced

obligation.statement: Projected execution must use the same admitted semantic responsibility exercised by direct semantic evaluation.

signal.statement: The projected feature produces the same observable signal as direct semantic execution.

resultShape.rationale: The signal reports execution conformance status; observations remain separate evaluation evidence.

when.text: their expectation, execution, AST, and code relationships are reviewed

then.text: one terminal canonical-feature construction disposition is produced

obligation.statement: Declared expectation, direct semantic execution, and projected execution must be canonically equivalent.

signal.statement: Canonical meaning is conserved across authority, AST, source, and both execution surfaces.

resultShape.rationale: The terminal signal reports the comparison disposition; the compared evidence remains independently addressable.

questions: Does each stage consume only admitted products of earlier stages?
Does every scenario carry one obligation, expectation, responsibility, signal, and semantic operation?
Can every feature-body operation be traced to semantic execution?
Can every AST node be traced to feature-body authority?
Can every projected source construct be traced to the expected AST?
Are direct semantic and projected observations canonically equivalent to the declared expectation?

translationTieOut.authority: Each feature body accepts one immutable context.
translationTieOut.ast: Each function declaration has one immutable context parameter.
translationTieOut.code: Each projected function accepts one typed context parameter.

translationTieOut.authority: Each feature body invokes exactly one admitted semantic edge.
translationTieOut.ast: Each function body contains one awaited call expression.
translationTieOut.code: Each projected function returns one awaited context invocation.

translationTieOut.authority: Each semantic edge ID equals its scenario semantic operation ID.
translationTieOut.ast: Each call contains the edge ID as one string literal.
translationTieOut.code: Each context invocation names the admitted semantic edge.

translationTieOut.authority: Domain branching and DTO construction are forbidden.
translationTieOut.ast: No branch or object-construction nodes are admitted.
translationTieOut.code: No if, switch, loop, or object construction is projected.

reviewAuthority.admissionRule: Admit implementation only when construction order is complete and expectation, semantic execution, AST, projected execution, and review are canonically equivalent.
